title: Builder Signals · 2026-11-03
summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 22 条 X 动态、1 集播客、0 篇博客；本站精选 9 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Andrej Karpathy · 前 Tesla AI 负责人、OpenAI 创始成员
featured.summaryEn: Karpathy built HackerTube as a weekend hack: annoyed with YouTube recommendations, he had Claude filter 43M comments from 20 years of HN down to 6,454 repeatedly recommended videos. The site needs no login (state lives in the local browser), uses a mid-video frame instead of A/B-optimized thumbnails, and ships the underlying analysis as a zip so you can point your own Claude at it. It took ~2 hours with Claude Code desktop on Opus 5.5 (Medium effort); his only manual steps were a Google Cloud API key, booting a VP…
featured.insightZh: Karpathy 周末做了个小项目 HackerTube：嫌 YouTube 推荐太烂，他让 Claude 过滤了 HN 二十年、4300 万条评论，挑出 6,454 个被反复推荐的视频，做成一个免登录（状态存在本地浏览器）、缩略图取视频中段真实画面而非 A/B 测试优化封面的观影站，底层评论分析数据也打包公开，可以让自己的 Claude 据此做个人版本。全程约 2 小时，用 Claude Code 桌面版 + Opus 5.5 Medium effort，他只和 Claude 对话；手工部分仅限申请 Google Cloud API key、开 VPS、买域名，之后把 IP 交给 Claude，让它完成更新、加固、部署和优化。他的结论：很多原本要几周甚至几个月的项目，现在「早饭前就能 few-shot 出来」。

featured.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
featured.summaryEn: Levie argues that "helping agents do their work" is becoming the new job description for many roles beyond coding. We are shifting from agents making us incrementally faster to us enabling agents — turning individual contributors into managers of agent teams. The biggest impact will hit information-heavy jobs: coding, cybersecurity, legal, biotech, engineering. Crucially, leverage decouples from hours worked, since agents can parallelize execution; people and organizations that reorganize around this sooner will s…
featured.insightZh: Levie 认为「人帮 agent 干活」正在成为大量岗位的新职位描述，不只是写代码：我们正从「agent 让人做得稍快稍好」转向「人去帮助 agent 完成工作」，每个人都变成一支 agent 团队的管理者，而非只是被 AI 加了点杠杆的个人贡献者。受冲击最大的是信息密集型岗位——编程、网络安全、法律、生物科技、工程等。关键变化在于：知识工作的产出第一次与投入工时脱钩，因为 agent 可以并行执行；越早发现并围绕这一点重组运营的个人和组织，越能获得复利式收益。

featured.title: Ep 95: Modal CEO on the Future of Inference, the Chaos of the GPU Market & Origins of the Sandbox Bet
featured.summaryEn: Plain token-serving inference is a race to the bottom; the durable moat is a multi-product platform spanning sandboxes, inference, training and storage — while GPU procurement remains a Wild West of WhatsApp groups and hotel-lobby deals. Redpoint GP Patrick Chase hosts Modal founder and CEO Eric for a second time. On compute: Modal closes two to three compute deals a week across 25 clouds. He describes GTC as "an open-air drug market, but for GPUs," with capacity found through late-night WhatsApp groups and personal connections. Compute is heterogeneous in location, disk, networking and reliability, so it can't trade like a fungible contract; many neoclouds are ex-crypto miners with shaky operations, and Modal's value lies in aggregating demand and pulling failing capacity out of rotation. He flags a structural risk: GPU commitments often require only ~30% upfront, so raising $1B can lo…
featured.insightZh: 裸卖 token 的推理市场会是一场向下竞争，真正持久的壁垒是「沙箱 + 推理 + 训练 + 存储」的多产品平台；而 GPU 市场仍是一个靠 WhatsApp 群和酒店大堂交易的「狂野西部」。 Redpoint GP Patrick Chase 再次对话 Modal 创始人兼 CEO Eric。关于算力：Modal 现在每周要谈两到三笔算力交易，接入 25 家云。他形容 GTC 像「露天 GPU 黑市」，靠深夜 WhatsApp 群、酒店大堂交换号码甚至销售 VP 表亲的高尔夫球友拿到卡。算力因地域、磁盘、网络、可靠性差异巨大，不是可在交易所买卖的标准化合约；不少 neocloud 由前加密矿工转型，可靠性堪忧，Modal 的价值正是聚合需求、自动剔除故障节点。他还提醒结构性风险：GPU 承诺通常只需预付约 30%，融 10 亿美元就能锁 30 亿算力，形成隐性杠杆并依赖后续融资；若 VC 收紧，部分 neolab 可能转型为 neocloud 转售算力（Mistral 已有先例）。 产品层面：沙箱产品 2023 年推出，过去 12 个月增长近千倍，已占收入约三分之一、独立年化收入 3 亿美元；LLM 推理在 DeepSeek 时刻后发力，也占约三分之一，并刚推出专用推理与训练产品。客户包括 Cognition（推理 + RL rollout 沙箱）、Ramp（后台编码 agent）、Suno、Runway、Decagon、DoorDash 及生物计算、机器人公司。他判断推理市场「straight down the middle 卖 token」会被 OpenRouter 商品化，kernel/KV cache 优化会被快速复制，持久差异化在平台组合；Modal 积极向 vLLM、SGLang 贡献，因为 alpha 在自动扩缩容等基础设施层。 组织与人才：Modal 合并的代码约 95% 由 agent 参与编写，但基础设施的长尾可靠性风险仍需人类监督；出乎意料的是资深工程师比初级更积极采用 agent——相当于拥有 10 个实习生，给一套 POSIX 文件系统测试…

items.title: Peter Yang · Roblox 产品负责人、AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: Peter Yang shared his current AI tool split: browser/computer use goes to ChatGPT + Codex, design/video editing/"taste" to Claude, 24/7 agents and scheduled jobs to Grok Bot — and Gemini is underrated for writing. He also quoted Google Labs product director @jacalulu: creating, learning and entertainment still need a human in the UI, but many products she'd happily stop using directly — raising the question of whether your product needs a UI at all. He previewed upcoming Behind the Craft guests: OpenAI VP of Produ…
items.insightZh: Peter Yang 给出了他当前的「AI 工具分工表」：浏览器 / 电脑操作用 ChatGPT + Codex，设计、视频剪辑和「品味」类工作用 Claude，7×24 agent 与定时任务用 Grok Bot，并认为 Gemini 在写作上被低估。他还引用 Google Labs 产品总监 @jacalulu 的观点：创造类、学习类、娱乐消费类产品仍需要人来操作 UI，但很多现有产品人其实乐于「不再亲自用」——这逼问产品团队：你的产品到底需不需要 UI？另外他预告了 Behind the Craft 新一期嘉宾，包括 OpenAI 产品 VP Ashley Alexander、Claude Design 背后的 Anthropic 设计师 Nate Parrott、coding agent 技能 GitHub 30 万+ star 的 Matt Pocock，以及仅 10 人、每年 3200 万美元 Claude 花费的游戏公司创始人 Jacob Sansbury。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Rauch's message: "Own your intelligence" — anyone opposing it likely wants to sell your intelligence back to you. Massive models may not run locally yet, but local models must keep proliferating; keep your options open by owning your harness, data, connections and runtime — your agents — and embrace open source. He also noted Gemini is doing well on two high-complexity projects he's testing.
items.insightZh: Rauch 喊出「Own your intelligence」：反对者多半是想把你自己的智能再卖回给你。超大模型短期内难以本地运行，但本地模型需要继续扩散，最好的策略是保持选择权——拥有自己的 harness、数据、连接、运行时，也就是自己的 agent，拥抱开源。他也提到正在两个高复杂度项目上测试 Gemini，表现不错。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Masad warned that anyone on a subsidized AI subscription should prepare to get rug-pulled. He also highlighted a one-toggle Replit feature: enable the "feedback widget" on your site and user feedback becomes prompts for the agents to build — closing the loop from user input to shipped changes.
items.insightZh: Masad 警告：正在享受补贴价 AI 订阅的用户要做好被「抽地毯」的准备。另外他介绍了 Replit 的一个开关功能：站点启用「feedback widget」后，用户反馈会直接变成 agent 的构建 prompt，形成从用户声音到产品迭代的自动闭环。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: Garry Tan highlighted Particle-1, which matches much larger models on agentic retrieval at 1/23 the price. He also said practical robotics is near, and that YC is the YC for hard tech.
items.insightZh: Garry Tan 转推 Particle-1：在 agentic retrieval（智能体检索）上效果媲美大得多的模型，价格却只有 1/23。他同时表示「实用机器人时代将至」，并称 YC 也是 hard tech 领域的 YC。

items.title: Thariq · 前 Anthropic Claude Code 成员
items.summaryEn: Thariq continues building his game: a new fire-wielding taekwondo master character, an art switch from 3D models to generated sprites, and a highlight intro video — aiming for a vertical slice next week.
items.insightZh: Thariq 在持续推进自己的游戏项目：新增一个用火焰战斗的跆拳道大师角色，美术从 3D 模型改为生成式 sprite，还做了一段角色高光开场视频，目标是下周做出一个可玩的 vertical slice。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder
items.summaryEn: Zara Zhang shared a playful build: what if your Linktree were an actual tree.
items.insightZh: Zara Zhang 发布了一个趣味小作品：把 Linktree 做成一棵「真正的树」。
